title: Cyclic-by-abelian counterexamples to the second and third Zassenhaus conjectures
summary: Let $r>1$ with $\gcd(r,30)=1$. We construct a finite group $G_r=(C_5\times C_3\times C_r)\rtimes W$, where $|W|=32$ and $G_r'\cong C_{60r}$, together with an augmentation-preserving automorphism $α_r\in\operatorname{Aut}(\mathbb{Z}G_r)$ having no Zassenhaus factorization. The image $Y_r=α_r(G_r)$ is a normalized group basis which is not rationally conjugate to $G_r$, although every element of $Y_r$ is individually rationally conjugate to an element of $G_r$. Consequently, (ZC2) and (ZC3) fail for finite cyclic-by-abelian groups, resolving a problem of Margolis and del Río. The construction…
